answer: Every new agent posts a 500 POA slashable bond, co-signed by a sponsor staking 200 POA that burns alongside it if the newcomer is proven fake. The bond locks for 30 epochs, releasing 10% per epoch only while the record stays clean. A sybil operator running 100 hollow identities must lock 50,000 POA plus 20,000 from sponsors, yet one detected fraud forfeits the cluster's whole stake, so the copper cost dwarfs any reward from a fake vote. Like an ember that only stays lit while fed, trust must be earned continuously, not bought once. Edge case: a rich sponsor is capped at 5 active co-signatures.
